recipes.title: Crispy Chicken Thigh Power Bowl with Cilantro-Lime Sauce

items.i: 4 servings rice (low-carb protein rice, regular, brown rice or quinoa)

steps: Toss the thighs with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika, thyme or oregano, cayenne and the baking powder. Roast at 400°F (200°C) for 40–45 minutes until crispy. Remove the skin afterwards if you like.
Blend the yogurt, mayo, scallions, cilantro, jalapeño, lime juice, chipotle powder and salt. Taste and adjust.
Toss the cucumbers, red onion and cilantro with the olive oil, lemon juice and salt.
Cook 4 servings of your rice of choice.
Add rice to each bowl, then a chicken thigh, two spoonfuls of cucumber salad and 2 avocado slices, and drizzle with the sauce.
recipes.notes: Recipe is the creator's; his macros (560 cal, 55 g protein, 15 g net carbs) use his low-carb protein rice, so they'll be higher in carbs with regular rice. Fat wasn't given.
